source: Rauhut and Pol 2017, Ameghiniana 54, Fig. 10, tree 2: one of three simplified theropod trees showing the possible positions of Pandoravenator (bold); vertical, root at the bottom, tip names written upwards above the branches, collapsed clades as triangles (shaded by group), node dots with clade names.
